sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent run of form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while visitors Alsager Town are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points and have lost four of their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach, with both sides sitting in the upper reaches of the table. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting between two strong performers—Bridgnorth have won four of their last five, while Eccleshall have won three of their last five despite a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a match between sides with contrasting form; Casuals are in strong shape while Wednesfield have mixed results recently. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a clash between mid-table sides, with Bilston (6th) showing solid recent form including a win. Barnton host Shawbury United—Barnton are unbeaten in their last two, while Shawbury are struggling with a four-game losing streak before their most recent win. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half encounter; New Mills have lost their last two while Drayton are inconsistent. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both sides fighting in the lower half—Crewe have lost three of their last five while Allscott picked up wins in their last two. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle; both sides are among the division's weakest performers with minimal recent success. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom club with just 2 points and a run of five consecutive losses before a recent draw.
